limitations: Selection, informative opportunity and between-player identification limit interpretation.

claim_summary: The primary replication panel comprised 13 seasons, 4,117 player-seasons and 857 accounting players. Of these, 3,980 positive-FTA rows from 835 players contributed 469,099 attempts; 137 zero-FTA rows remained in accounting. The 2013-14 development season was excluded. A grouped-binomial logistic model adjusted for barefoot height, original combine position and season; player-cluster CR1 covariance and a predeclared 2,000-replicate player bootstrap quantified uncertainty.
limitations: Selection, informative opportunity and between-player identification limit interpretation.

This is a between-player association and does not represent changing one player's anatomy.

Each additional inch of wingspan beyond that expected for height was associated with approximately 3% lower adjusted odds of a made free throw. Odds are not percentage points. This is a between-player association and does not represent changing one player's anatomy.
limitations: Selection, informative opportunity and between-player identification limit interpretation.

The supplementary attempt-volume diagnostic makes the residual pattern visible without making model misfit the main result.

claim_summary: The main limitations are selected measurement coverage, informative shooting opportunity and possible conditional-mean misspecification, and between-player confounding. These models showed posterior predictive misspecification or weak identification among opportunity and player-level latent effects, with predictive checks withheld when sampling failed. They were therefore not used for primary scientific inference. Their adequacy failures remain part of the scientific history.
